label: External Target Example
notes: Copy this file into another repository or local path and replace commands with real adapter scripts.
Select a core-owned evaluator profile through rubric.evaluator_profile_path or --evaluator-profile instead of carrying target_reached policy inside adapter.json.

Make the verification provider emit both a live interaction artifact and a structured verification-witness manifest, because target_reached now requires verifier-owned live proof with grounded witness steps.
Publish target_manifest URLs from run_target so the harness runtime can independently confirm live browser/API assertions before it emits target_reached.
